title: Incomplete investigation — independent quality challenge
case_summary: The investigator records that incoming payments are customer business receipts but does not identify the payers, establish the purpose of each payment or provide supporting evidence.
customer_statement: Customer says the payments relate to business sales. No invoices or sales records are included in the supplied case file.

recorded_facts.text: Two incoming payments totalling AUD 16,500 and one outgoing payment of AUD 15,000 are listed.

customer_statements.text: Customer says incoming payments are business sales.

observations: Investigation narrative accepts the customer's explanation without recording supporting evidence.
unknowns: Whether the payments are consistent with account history.
next_enquiries: Obtain and assess proportionate sales support.
Explain the outgoing payment and update the case rationale.
provisional_position: No further action required; payments are normal business receipts.
quality_notes: The recorded conclusion is stronger than the evidence supplied. The independent reviewer should challenge the unsupported outcome and require a revised assessment.
